# Google AI Mode 购物推荐的体验与优化方法

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-05-12 14:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1921809353604030560
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

@samythll @ConnorGillivan @irentdumpsters @SEOKeval 4. Google 已在 AI Mode 中上线购物整合功能，完整分析见 @brodieseo 的推文：
https://x.com/brodieseo/status/1920455605367812146

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Brodie Clark @brodieseo](<https://x.com/brodieseo/status/1920455605367812146>)

Google 再次证明了为什么它在购物领域无可匹敌：仅仅几天之后，它就推出了与 ChatGPT 竞争的产品。

Google 的 AI Mode 商品推荐功能已经上线。在测试过 ChatGPT Shopping 之后，目前这个体验让我相当满意。

有几个重点值得强调：

• 一致性：当你在 AI Mode 中多次提交同一个查询时，结果不会有太大的差异。在我看来，如果 AI 真正理解了要求，就应该是这样。（ChatGPT 每次给出的结果都完全不同。）

• 体验：购物体验流畅得多。虽然两者都支持点击结果后查看知识面板，但 Google 拥有通过 GMC Next 提交的商品数据源，因此具备竞争优势——这些数据让信息的质量和准确性都高得多。

• 差异：AI Mode 商品推荐与以网格形式展示的标准免费商品详情结果之间，最主要的区别在于，前者会引用网页来发现商品，再以免费商品详情的形式输出。我认为，相比浏览更庞大的可选商品目录，这对购物者会很有用。

• 参考链接：Google 似乎为商品信息引入了一种新的参考资料形式，提供了详尽的商品相关信息概览，超出了标准知识面板的范围。在新窗口打开带下划线的链接时，你会进入一个内容非常丰富、由商品数据源驱动的页面体验，效果相当不错。

对于一些较难的查询，标准 Google Shopping 搜索结果以前无法给出有用的答案；我认为，这次推出的 AI Mode 对这些查询的购物者会尤其有帮助。如果你读过我的 ChatGPT Shopping 评测：https://brodieclark.com/chatgpt-shopping-vs-google/ ，就更能理解 Google 在这个领域领先了多少。

对于希望针对 AI Mode 购物结果进行优化的网站，免费商品详情优化策略的相同原则在这里也适用：https://brodieclark.com/google-organic-product-grids/ 。一个重要区别是，免费商品详情结果会在特定的评测文章中被引用（你可以查看）。这一点，再加上具备出现在知识面板结果中的资格，是取得成功的最佳组合。

## 英文原文

@samythll @ConnorGillivan @irentdumpsters @SEOKeval 4. Google has launched its shopping integration in AI mode, get the full breakdown in @brodieseo’s tweet:
https://x.com/brodieseo/status/1920455605367812146

### Quoted preview

[Brodie Clark @brodieseo](<https://x.com/brodieseo/status/1920455605367812146>)

Google has shown once again why they are unbeatable when it comes to Shopping, releasing their competing product to ChatGPT a few days later.

The release of Google's product recommendations in AI Mode is here, and I'm quite impressed by the experience so far after testing out ChatGPT Shopping.

Here are some important points worth highlighting:

• Consistency: when you submit the same query multiple times in AI Mode, the results don't differ too much. In my opinion, this is how it should be if the AI truly understands the brief (ChatGPT shows completely different results each time)

• Experience: the Shopping experience is much more seamless. While both have the knowledge panel function when clicking on results, Google has a competitive advantage with feeds submitted via GMC Next – making the information much higher quality and accurate

• Difference: the major difference among AI Mode product recommendations and standard free listing results that show as grids is that pages are referenced to uncover products, which are then produced in the free listings form – I can see this being quite useful for shoppers compared to browsing a more extensive catalog of options

• Reference Links: it seems that Google has introduced a new form of reference for product information, providing a thorough overview of product-related information that goes beyond a standard knowledge panel. When opening a link with an underline in a new window, it takes you to a very extensive product-feed driven experience which works quite well

For more difficult queries that standard Google Shopping results weren't providing useful results for, I can see this AI Mode release being especially useful to shoppers. And if you read my ChatGPT Shopping review: https://brodieclark.com/chatgpt-shopping-vs-google/ this underscores how far ahead Google are in this arena.

For sites that want to optimise for AI Mode Shopping results, the same principles of free listings optimisation tactics apply here: https://brodieclark.com/google-organic-product-grids/. The important difference is that the free listing results are being referenced in specific review articles (which you can check). This, combined with eligibility to appear within the knowledge panel results is the best combination for success.
